newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street open up on PPI data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street open up on PPI data.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened higher on Thursday, boosted by Producer Price Index figures that showed a mild December rise in core prices.
The Dow industrials were up 11 to 1327 and the Nasdaq Composite rose 6.32 to 1326.67.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was up 13/32 to yield 6.81. The Standard & Poors 500 futures index was up 1.30 to 756.90.
The Labor Department said prices rose 0.5 percent in December, with the crucial core rate, which excludes fuel and food, up 0.1 percent.
